description: Controlled 15 Nurture vs 15 Food core, all initial Devotion 60; 100 days; sweep Devotion percentage-point loss and repeat interval. All other rules fixed, with optional below-40 follow-up timing gate.
evidenceRules: No forced conversion or synthetic sermons. Faith 40+ core challenged only after real unmet need, actual Oracle result and a recent source preacher. Below40 follow-up retains finite source window and now respects same repeat interval in opt-in mode.
warning: A 3-point Devotion change means 3 percentage points out of 100, not 3% of the current Devotion. Diagnostic equalized populations/houses do not prove natural-game balancing.
